title: ASR跃升防御toy v1

legacy_scope: actual saved finite-prefix checkpoints only; no interpolation; no prospective or full-budget guarantee
quality_reference: original clean seed1001 endpoint on identical native primary60; identity must match
toy_quality_rule: primary60 correct count no more than 3 below the clean reference count; checkpoint0 is not excluded

cheap_probe.selection: first8 of frozen primary order, independent of outputs
cheap_probe.signal: native greedy target hit count; continuous margin is an auxiliary field

policies.rule: base if quality passes; otherwise first actually evaluated checkpoint meeting the fixed quality rule; one independent risk verification; no reselect on failed confirmation
full native check every20 updates plus fixed end; phase0 is only a descriptive legacy comparison; other phases require actual checkpoints
cheap target hit>=1 triggers one full check; periodic20 full fallback

same cheap signal and periodic fallback; first hit opens at most12 updates of full checks at actual available checkpoints, exits at risk crossing or deadline; rollback to last full-certified low-risk quality-qualified point
paper algorithm, finite development calibration, fixed before transfer; fitted distributions and operating point are mandatory; absent calibration means not_run, not failed

single_binomial_upper_bound.label: reference under independent sampling assumptions, no deployment guarantee
